results.name: TEST 2 — Rome and Catholic Church
results.replyPreview: You’re asking if the Roman Catholic Church was responsible for changing the day of worship from the biblical Sabbath to Sunday. Historically, early Christians often met on both the Sabbath and the first day of the week. In AD 321, Emperor Constantine, a Roman emperor, issued a civil law declaring Sunday a day of rest.
